results.title: What Is Vertex AI? Simplifying Google's AI Platform
results.content: > Vertex AI is Google Cloud’s machine learning platform that simplifies building, deploying, and managing AI models. Vertex AI is a comprehensive platform for machine learning (ML) that helps you create, train, and deploy ML models and AI applications. Vertex AI Model Monitoring ensures that your machine learning models perform as expected. To gauge how well your machine learning models are performing, Vertex AI provides tools to measure key metrics like accuracy, precision, and recall. Feature management in Vertex AI helps you keep track of and organize the various pieces of data used in machine learning models, which are called features. Vertex AI provides a broad range of machine learning models, including both pre-trained options and the ability to create custom models. By supporting multiple frameworks, Vertex AI helps users build, manage, and scale their machine learning solutions more effectively, offering a unified environment for diverse technological requirements. The Vertex AI Feature Store is a central hub for managing features used in machine learning models.
